activity.notes: Ching Shih (Zheng Yi Sao) already exists in ATLAS with an Activity opposing the Qing dynasty. This additional own-side Activity represents her effective command of the Canton/Guangdong pirate confederation after Zheng Yi's death in 1807 until the confederation accepted amnesty in 1810. The existing Qing opposition Activity is retained; no deletion is performed.

sources.title: Zheng Yi Sao — World History Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The biography describes Zheng Yi Sao taking over the pirate confederation after Zheng Yi's death in 1807 and ending her piracy through the 1810 Canton amnesty.

sources.title: History of the Pirates Who Infested the China Sea From 1807 to 1810
sources.citation_text: The translated contemporary account describes the six color-flag pirate squadrons around Canton and Zheng Yi Sao's place within the confederation.
